meta.parties: Silva Et Al. v. Appuhamy Et Al

rules.statement: Section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code does not apply to claims for debt secured by mortgage, and section 642 allows a creditor to appoint a representative without proving the estate's value if the mortgaged property is under Rs. 1,000.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think counsel for the appellants is right in arguing that it is not intended to bar claims against an estate for debt, and is not obligatory in such a case as this."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code; section 642 of the Civil Procedure Code
